protocol.authorization_scope: Versioned component qualification inside the existing user-approved independent VI RSS construction budget; no new allowance or formal planning authorization.

parent_remaining_before_component.policy: Fixed mathematical diagnosis consumes VI original wall/CPU but no candidate. No reset or automatic repeat.

protocol.fixed_coordinates: Only designated q4+=fraction*theta and q6-=fraction*theta. All other16 angles remain bitwise equal to original saved center, including q5=0. Do not change centers, branches, theta, h, geometry or source limits.
protocol.expected_branches: Designated meeting set[1,3]; active1 remains branch1 and other passive remains branch3. No unique label is falsely assigned to singular wrist.
protocol.FK_J_accounting: Per candidate poses_and_body requests3 mathematical arm FK/J and physical closure_vector_jacobian requests3, total36 mathematical calls if all6 finish. Each VI collision adapter query has1 native variant and independently calls arm_fk_jac for3 pose-consistency checks, adding18 adapter-internal arm FK/J: total54 for6 qualified candidates. No extra native FK crosscheck; compare all3 new mathematical poses to saved original native/B poses.
protocol.interrupted_FK_J_and_query_accounting: Mathematical requested/completed remain separate. Before collision dispatch, adapter_internal_arm_FK_J_requested increases by3. Only a returned qualified CHECKED result confirms all3 adapter internal starts/completions and1 native_collision_queries. On a failed/interrupted dispatch, confirmed started/completed/native counts are lower bounds; requested minus confirmed completed and dispatched minus confirmed native queries are explicitly retained as unresolved, never reported as completed.
protocol.image_diagnostic: Using the already evaluated physical J only, record the rank5 image residual of each corresponding old fixed active chord. This is a diagnostic, not regular-to-fiber ingress qualification or an extra model call.
protocol.positive_gate: All6 fixed points pass pose invariance/dual closure/expected independent ranks/branch sets/source bounds/actual qualified source-PQP checks. Original saved center plus theta/2 (219 only) plus endpoint have every raw full18 Euclidean leaf distance strictly<h. No wrapping or shortcut.
protocol.failure_policy: Preserve every fixed node and failure; do not replace points or retry. Protocol/interface/process/independent-rank inconsistency stops the run with retained prefix. Other node failures remain explicit non-PASS; no threshold relaxation.
scope_limits: Singular-fiber discrete component only; no regular-branch-to-fiber ingress tested.
Original Q2 UNKNOWN remains unchanged; this is not author-native RBS.
No global RSS result, all-mode equivalence, planning statistic, full-geometry or CCD certificate.
protocol.collision_qualification_scope: Qualified original discrete source pair/mesh/tolerance policy only; complete physical geometry, omitted pairs and CCD remain unverified.
protocol.one_shot_policy: New fixed atomic retained component claim. Original/B/Q2/center claims never modified. No repeat/reset; subtract actual6 or interrupted prefix and actual wall/CPU from parent remaining.
